00072 void DelayNUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00073 {
00074     double sampleRate = UGen::getSampleRate();
00075     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00076     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00077     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00078     float* delayTimeSamples = inputs[DelayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00079     LOCAL_DECLARE(float * const, bufferSamples);
00080     LOCAL_DECLARE(const double, delayBufferSize);
00081     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, bufferWritePos);
00082     
00083     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00084     {
00085         bufferSamples[bufferWritePos] = *inputSamples++;
00086         
00087         int bufferReadPos = bufferWritePos - (int)(*delayTimeSamples++ * sampleRate);
00088         if(bufferReadPos < 0)
00089             bufferReadPos += (int)delayBufferSize;
00090         
00091         *outputSamples++ = bufferSamples[bufferReadPos];
00092         
00093         bufferWritePos++;
00094         if(bufferWritePos >= delayBufferSize)
00095             bufferWritePos = 0;
00096     }   
00097     
00098     LOCAL_COPY(bufferWritePos);
00099 }

00171 void CombNUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00172 {
00173     double sampleRate = UGen::getSampleRate();
00174     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00175     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00176     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00177     float* delayTimeSamples = inputs[DelayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00178     float* decayTimeSamples = inputs[DecayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00179     LOCAL_DECLARE(float * const, bufferSamples);
00180     LOCAL_DECLARE(const double, delayBufferSize);
00181     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, bufferWritePos);
00182     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, currentDecay);
00183     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, feedback);
00184     
00185     if(*decayTimeSamples != currentDecay)
00186     {
00187         currentDecay = *decayTimeSamples;
00188         feedback = calcFeedback(*delayTimeSamples, currentDecay);
00189         LOCAL_COPY(currentDecay);
00190         LOCAL_COPY(feedback);
00191     }
00192     
00193     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00194     {
00195         int bufferReadPos = bufferWritePos - (int)(*delayTimeSamples++ * sampleRate);
00196         if(bufferReadPos < 0)
00197             bufferReadPos += (int)delayBufferSize;
00198         
00199         float value = bufferSamples[bufferReadPos];
00200         
00201         bufferSamples[bufferWritePos] = value * feedback + *inputSamples++;
00202         
00203         *outputSamples++ = value;
00204         
00205         bufferWritePos++;
00206         if(bufferWritePos >= delayBufferSize)
00207             bufferWritePos = 0;
00208     }   
00209     
00210     LOCAL_COPY(bufferWritePos);
00211 }

00296 void AllpassNUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00297 {
00298     double sampleRate = UGen::getSampleRate();
00299     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00300     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00301     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00302     float* delayTimeSamples = inputs[DelayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00303     float* decayTimeSamples = inputs[DecayTime].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00304     bool doesNotNeedToCalculate = true;
00305     LOCAL_DECLARE(float * const, bufferSamples);
00306     LOCAL_DECLARE(const double, delayBufferSize);
00307     LOCAL_DECLARE(int, bufferWritePos);
00308     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, currentDelay);
00309     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, currentDecay);
00310     LOCAL_DECLARE(float, feedback);
00311     
00312     if(*decayTimeSamples != currentDecay)   
00313     {
00314         currentDecay = *decayTimeSamples;
00315         doesNotNeedToCalculate = false;
00316         LOCAL_COPY(currentDecay);
00317     }
00318     
00319     float nextDelay = (float)(*delayTimeSamples * sampleRate);
00320     
00321     if(nextDelay != currentDelay)   
00322     {
00323         currentDelay = nextDelay;
00324         doesNotNeedToCalculate = false;
00325         LOCAL_COPY(currentDelay);
00326     }
00328     
00329     if(doesNotNeedToCalculate == false)
00330     {
00331         feedback = calcFeedback(*delayTimeSamples, currentDecay);
00332         LOCAL_COPY(feedback);
00333     }
00334     
00335     float currentDelayMax1 = std::max(1.f, currentDelay);
00336     
00337     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00338     {
00339         int bufferReadPos = bufferWritePos - (int)(currentDelayMax1);
00340         if(bufferReadPos < 0)
00341             bufferReadPos += (int)delayBufferSize;
00342         
00343         float inValue = bufferSamples[bufferReadPos];
00344         float outValue = inValue * feedback + *inputSamples++;
00345         
00346         bufferSamples[bufferWritePos] = outValue;
00347         
00348         *outputSamples++ = inValue - feedback * outValue;
00349         
00350         bufferWritePos++;
00351         if(bufferWritePos >= delayBufferSize)
00352             bufferWritePos = 0;
00353     }   
00354     
00355     LOCAL_COPY(bufferWritePos);
00356 }
